definitions.function: uchrom.fea.separation_profile (SeparationParams defaults: short [1, 2) Mb, long [19, 54) Mb midpoint to midpoint, chrX / chrY / chrM left out; profile edges = 1-Mb offsets 0-199)
definitions.seq_ratio: log2((n_short + 0.5) / (n_long + 0.5)) per cell (map offset 1 over offsets 19-53); cells with >= 500 cis contacts between different bins
definitions.imaging_dist_ratio: log2(median d of pairs 19-54 Mb apart / median d of pairs 1-2 Mb apart) per cell, pairs within a chromosome copy; cells with >= 10 short and >= 30 long pairs
definitions.contrast: difference of medians, bootstrap 95% CI over cells, Cliff's delta, Mann-Whitney P (cells as independent)
definitions.depth_adjusted: OLS value ~ class + log10 depth (cis contacts; imaging: spots), bootstrap CI

set_meta.homologs: authors' DBSCAN labelID: (cell, chromosome) kept when it has exactly two labels, one spot per locus per label

paired_hic_mouse_cortex.note: per-cell ratios not used (too few contacts per cell): pooled by class only

hicrna_mouse_brain.assay: spatial Hi-C-RNA (Guo 2026), spots by dominant type

hicrna_mouse_brain_domains_r1.assay: spatial Hi-C-RNA (Guo 2026), section r1 by the authors' domains
